name: Runner Extras - TestPage filter repositioning
brief: Pins that applying a filter through TestPage.Filter.SetFilter re-positions the page onto a row the filter actually admits.
description: Applying a filter to a page changes which rows exist. A page left sitting on a row the new filter excludes reports values from a record that is not on the page at all — so the test reads a plausible-looking value belonging to the wrong row and the failure names a data problem rather than a cursor problem.
